readerCopy.body: One person can keep offering help while another keeps proving that accepting it would cost too much autonomy. When the Moon opposes Chiron, care and sensitivity face each other directly, creating a cycle in which the giver pushes harder and the receiver refuses more firmly until both feel misunderstood. Care becomes easier to receive when it stops being compulsory. Help becomes more useful when its terms leave enough room for both people to agree to the exchange.
